items.title: 68514_Horace Henderson oral history interview
items.q: I had a drummer named Debo Mills. We called him Danny Bo. ... Israel Crosby was in my band. ... John Hammond had me get Israel Crosby, Emmet Barry, and myself together.

ctx.x: It's listed here. There are four tracks you have, or you don't -- let's see -- 'You Don't Mean No Good.' That must be --
That's the one Danny Bo sang to his
wife. That's the blues. John Hammond was a blues fiend, as you know.
